correctness.rationale: For 0<u<1, solve u=x(2−x−y) to find x∈[1−sqrt(1−u),1]. The second target h_u(x) has h_uʺ=−2γ−2Au/x³<0, with positive derivative at the left endpoint and negative derivative at the right, giving precisely two strictly interior predecessors iff v0(u)<v<v*(u). Its unique nondegenerate critical point lies on y_c(t)=2(1−t)(A+γt)/A; the allowable arc is t∈[max(0,1−A/(2γ)),1]. The change of variables along u_c(t) gives the exact two rational area branches and their difference (2γ−A)^5/(480 A γ³), proving C4 but not C5. The embedded symbolic checker verifies all algebraic steps and exact witnesses; the analytical argument proves the universal quantifiers.

value.rationale: Exact target-space area and maximal biological backward multiplicity quantify recovery ambiguity from a single ecological observation, a natural inverse-dynamics invariant. The nontrivial fifth-order contact at a fold/boundary-attachment transition and the exact 2/17 fraction at the threshold reveal structure invisible to fixed-point bifurcations. It persists for strict-interior trajectories in a forward invariant, globally convergent population regime, so the inverse ambiguity is not a chaotic-attractor artifact. This is not merely a finite example or a textbook normalization.
